_comment: Placeable equipment. footprint = [width_x, depth_z] metres when facing +Z (with clearance). price = Shop price for an extra one. station_type mirrors the wrapper scene's StationBase type. auto = automation behaviour (belt/arm/rack/robot), read by Automation and Sim.

fixtures.name: Office desk + PC
fixtures.desc: Runs PaneOS: purchasing, sales, stock, finance. More PCs = more people buying and listing at once.

fixtures.name: Test bench
fixtures.desc: One unit + one USB at a time. Diagnostics or wipe & image.

fixtures.name: Repair bench
fixtures.desc: ESD mat, tools and a lamp. Fix faults with parts from the bins.

fixtures.name: Grading desk
fixtures.desc: Light box and label printer for consistent grading.

fixtures.name: Packing table
fixtures.desc: Boxes, foam, tape gun and label printer.

fixtures.name: Stock shelving (12 bays)
fixtures.desc: Boltless steel shelving. Four decks of three laptops or small desktops. Too shallow for servers and towers.

fixtures.name: Heavy-duty racking (6 bays)
fixtures.desc: Pallet-racking style bays for rack servers, tower servers and tower desktops (laptops fit too).

fixtures.name: OUTGOING shelf
fixtures.desc: The courier collects packed orders from here. Two floor bays take large boxes (towers, rack servers).

fixtures.name: Parts bins
fixtures.desc: Spare parts storage. Repair benches draw from bins.

fixtures.name: Roller conveyor (2 m)
fixtures.desc: Powered rollers, 0.6 m between the rails (19-inch rack servers fit). Ends snap together; an open end is a pick-up point for robot arms; put kit on the near end to send it along.

fixtures.name: Conveyor curve (right)
fixtures.desc: 90-degree turn to the right.

fixtures.name: Conveyor curve (left)
fixtures.desc: 90-degree turn to the left.

fixtures.name: Goods-in scanner
fixtures.desc: Barcode arch on a conveyor: every unit through it is booked into stock automatically.

fixtures.name: Diverter / sorter
fixtures.desc: Routes kit left, right or straight on by what it needs next. Look at an exit and press E to change its rule.

fixtures.name: Vision grader
fixtures.desc: Camera tunnel that grades imaged units as they pass and lists them on Flogit.

fixtures.name: Pick-and-place robot arm
fixtures.desc: Picks kit up within 1.8 m and puts it where it needs to go next: racks, robots, conveyors, stock, OUTGOING.

fixtures.name: Network test rack (6 bays)
fixtures.desc: Network-booted diagnostics for six units at once. No USB needed; robot arms can load it.

fixtures.name: Network imaging rack (6 bays)
fixtures.desc: Secure wipe and PaneOS deploy for six units at once over the network.

fixtures.name: Repair robot cell
fixtures.desc: Fixes level 1 faults (batteries, RAM, drives, keys, fans, PSUs) using parts from the bins.

fixtures.name: Packing robot
fixtures.desc: Boxes, tapes and labels sold units; the parcel comes out ready for the OUTGOING shelf.

fixtures.name: Flexible conveyor bend
fixtures.desc: Bends to any angle from 15° to 180° (scroll while placing), tighter or wider (Shift+scroll), left or right (T). Up to 4 m of belt.

fixtures.name: Merger (side input right)
fixtures.desc: A side conveyor joins the line here; kit merges in when there's a gap.

fixtures.name: Merger (side input left)
fixtures.desc: A side conveyor joins the line here; kit merges in when there's a gap.

fixtures.name: Automated stock tower (24 trays)
fixtures.desc: Vertical lift store. Feed graded stock in by conveyor (front-left hatch); when it sells, it comes out on the right-hand hatch on its own. You can load and pick by hand too.

fixtures.name: WEEE recycling cage
fixtures.desc: Kit that can never be fixed goes in here for licensed recycling — paid as scrap. Robot arms use it for units with locked accounts or dead boards beyond repair.

fixtures.name: Splitter / balancer
fixtures.desc: One line in, two out (left and right). Alternate shares kit between two lines; Overflow fills the left and only uses the right when the left backs up. Press E on it to switch.

fixtures.name: Stop gate (1 m)
fixtures.desc: A pneumatic gate across the belt. Press E to hold the line (kit waits behind it — safe to step in and sort things out) or open it again.

fixtures.name: People's hatch (take & send on)
fixtures.desc: Lets people join the line anywhere. Kit coming in stops at the pick face for a person to take; anything put on the far half rides on down the line. Chains like a 1.6 m conveyor.

fixtures.name: Line monitor
fixtures.desc: A big floor-standing screen that shows the line live: machine moves per hour, kit on the belts, what every machine is doing, and the bottleneck in red.

fixtures.name: Pallet racking (3 bays × 3 levels)
fixtures.desc: Proper pallet racking: nine bays for whole pallets of stock. A forklift reaches every level; the bottom level works with the hand pallet truck too. Units on racked pallets stay in the Stock app.

fixtures.name: Low pallet racking (2 bays × 2 levels)
fixtures.desc: Two levels of pallet racking that fit under a low roof (garages and lock-ups). Forklift for the top level, pallet truck or forklift for the floor.

fixtures.name: Pallet unload bay
fixtures.desc: A marked floor bay with yellow guides. Drop a pallet in it with the forklift or pallet truck and any robot arm in reach unloads it onto the goods-in conveyor (or straight to a test rack).

fixtures.name: Office plant (tall)
fixtures.desc: A big leafy yucca in a glazed pot. Makes the place feel looked after. Doesn't need much — like most of your staff.

fixtures.name: Snake plant
fixtures.desc: Unkillable. Perfect for a workshop.

fixtures.name: Entrance mat / rug
fixtures.desc: Heavy-duty rug in your accent colour. Lies flat, so desks and benches can stand on it.

fixtures.name: Site radio
fixtures.desc: A chunky builder's radio in a roll cage. Press E to switch it on or off. Every workshop needs one.

fixtures.name: Wall clock
fixtures.desc: A station-style wall clock that keeps the in-game time. Place it against a wall.

fixtures.name: Poster: Lift with your legs
fixtures.desc: Framed health & safety poster. Place it against a wall.

fixtures.name: Poster: Buy it. Fix it. Flip it.
fixtures.desc: Your company motto, framed, in your accent colour. Place it against a wall.

fixtures.name: Poster: Halden home computer (1987)
fixtures.desc: A vintage advert for the Halden HC-64. Before your time. Place it against a wall.

fixtures.name: Employee of the Month frame
fixtures.desc: Whoever did the most work last week goes up on the wall every Monday — with their photo if they've uploaded one.
